item.title: The journey together
item.dc:creator: Cuochi senza fuochi
item.description:
Almost everybody in this photo had met for the first time about two hours earlier.

The venue is what we usually get: a borrowed common room, tables pushed where they fit, chairs dragged in from next door. Everything on those tables arrived as shopping and got turned into something by the people standing around it. Nothing was switched on all evening.

That is the part worth repeating, because people assume the opposite. Nobody carried a finished dish across town. You walk in with empty hands, somebody hands you a bag of biscuits to crush, and an hour later there is dessert.

People stayed standing and talking long after the plates were empty, which is the part that actually matters.

This is what we mean when we say come on your own. It is the normal way to arrive.
